DeterministicGreedy.execution_policy: Deterministic 1-pass construction; completes immediately without artificial wait

CPSat.execution_policy: Google OR-Tools CP-SAT single worker deterministic search with max_time_in_seconds = 2.0

SimulatedAnnealing.execution_policy: Continuous cooling loop running for wall-clock time limit = 2.0s
SimulatedAnnealing.monotonicity_rule: best_objective_so_far is non-increasing across all iterations

HybridCPSatSA.execution_policy: CP-SAT runs up to 1.0s to obtain incumbent; SA refines incumbent for remaining 1.0s
HybridCPSatSA.monotonicity_rule: best_objective_so_far is non-increasing from CP-SAT incumbent

historical_claim_invalidation.historical_claim: Hybrid CP-SAT + SA is superior to standalone CP-SAT under time-limited benchmark
historical_claim_invalidation.audit_finding: Phase F benchmark granted CP-SAT 5.0s and then added 300 SA iterations to Hybrid, giving Hybrid unequal compute.
historical_claim_invalidation.action: Invalidated historical claim. Certified strictly under R26 equal total compute (2.0s) contract.
